text: G42's board is chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Ruler of Abu Dhabi, and includes Khaldoon Khalifa Al Mubarak, Mubadala's group chief executive, and Jassem Mohamed Bu Ataba Al Zaabi, chairman of the Abu Dhabi Department of Finance.

source.name: G42: G42 Announces Investment by Silver Lake
source.quote: H.E. Jassem Mohamed Obaid Bu Ataba Al Zaabi, Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Department of Finance; and H.E. Khaldoon Khalifa Al Mubarak, Group Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director of Mubadala Investment Company

additionalSources.name: Mubadala: His Excellency Khaldoon Khalifa Al Mubarak (undated profile, read September 2026)
additionalSources.quote: He serves on the Board of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC), L’IMAD Holding Company, and G42, the Abu Dhabi headquartered global AI company.

additionalSources.name: Abu Dhabi Media Office: Tahnoon bin Zayed chairs G42 Board of Directors meeting
additionalSources.quote: The board, comprising esteemed participants including His Excellency Khaldoon Khalifa Al Mubarak, His Excellency Jassem Mohamed Bu Ataba Al Zaabi, Brad Smith, Egon Durban, Peng Xiao, and Martin Edelman

additionalSources.name: Aletihad (WAM): Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan chairs G42’s final board meeting of 2024
additionalSources.quote: H.H. Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Ruler of Abu Dhabi and Chairman of G42, presided over the final board meeting of 2024 for G42
